1.0.1.en: Icons, reaadmes and better error handling

1.1.3.en: Fixed potential issue on app uninstall

1.1.4.en: Fixed device repeatedly going unavailable: interval clearing, token refresh on expiry, tariff errors no longer affect device availability

1.1.5.en: Fixed bugs causing constant offline/online flips

1.1.7.en: Another fix for constant device disconnections

1.2.0.en: New Glow gas meter (local) and Glow electricity meter (local) devices read your Glow display's MQTT feed directly, without the internet, and bring gas into Homey Energy. Fixes for the cloud Display and CAD device: account entries that return errors are skipped, the login renews itself, and Tariff changed now fires. This version needs Homey 12.9.0 or later. Homeys on older firmware stay on version 1.1.7 and don't get the cloud fixes, so update Homey first.

1.3.0.en: Display and CAD (API) is now called Electricity meter (cloud). It shows electricity used today and yesterday with its cost, the standing charge and when Glowmarkt's data is up to, and has new flow cards for each day's figures, exporting, and a meter or account that stops working. New Gas meter (cloud) device: gas for the latest complete day with its cost, unit rate and standing charge, and a card for each day once its figures are final. Daily costs include the day's standing charge, as in the Bright app; costs use the unit rate and standing charge Glowmarkt reports, which may not match a time-of-use tariff. The local meters are now called Electricity meter (local) and Gas meter (local), and the electricity meter gets Started exporting, Stopped exporting and Is exporting cards. The tariff is now checked every half hour, changing a device's settings no longer starts a second set of polls, and the Copy buttons on the settings page now work when Homey blocks the clipboard.
